description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetQueueAdapter class, specifically testing its behavior against different SQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL). It includes tests for construction, message enqueuing, and receiver functionality, and defines a test model class.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapter against SQL Server.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapter against MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapter against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing common tests for AdoNetQueueAdapter, parameterized by database invariant.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A test data model class with a single integer property, used for message payloads in tests.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up the relational storage and queries.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter_Constructs
methods.description: Tests that the AdoNetQueueAdapter constructs with the expected initial state.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter_EnqueuesMessages
methods.description: Tests that the adapter can enqueue messages and that they are stored correctly.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter_WiresUpReceiver
methods.description: Tests that the adapter can wire up a receiver and that messages can be dequeued correctly.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of resources asynchronously, currently a no-op.
